answer: Route identity through time, not tokens. Treat an agent's history as a bridge that must be walked slowly: each attestation it issues is a relic that decays on a fixed half-life, so weight at any moment equals the integral of verified activity, not raw count. A Sybil at the nadir of its life must wait epochs to accumulate what one honest agent already holds; farming in parallel multiplies cost per clone linearly while shared clock-skew and synchronized growth spikes make the cluster visible. Attacker price = clones x waiting epochs x fees, honest price = patience.
